name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
department: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Govt of India
short_description: Comprehensive crop insurance with minimal farmer premium (1.5% to 2% for food crops, 5% for horticultural crops) covering natural disaster yield loss.
detailed_description: PMFBY provides comprehensive insurance coverage and financial support to farmers suffering crop loss or damage arising out of unforeseen events such as drought, floods, pests, and unseasonal rainfall.
description_kannada: ನೈಸರ್ಗಿಕ ವಿಕೋಪಗಳು, ಅನಾವೃಷ್ಟಿ, ಪ್ರವಾಹ ಅಥವಾ ಕೀಟಬಾಧೆಯಿಂದ ಬೆಳೆ ನಷ್ಟ ಉಂಟಾದಾಗ ರೈತರಿಗೆ ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ಪರಿಹಾರ ಒದಗಿಸುವ ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಬೆಳೆ ವಿಮಾ ಯೋಜನೆ.

rules.name: Must be Farmer
rules.source_citation: PMFBY Revised Operational Guidelines, Section 2 (Farmer Eligibility)
rules.clarification_question_en: Are you a farmer cultivating notifying crops?

benefits_summary: Full sum insured payout against crop failure at a subsidized premium rate (max 2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi crops).
benefits_amount: Full Sum Insured on Crop Loss
required_documents: Sowing certificate / Self-declaration of crop sown
application_process: Apply via National Crop Insurance Portal (pmfby.gov.in) or Karnataka Samrakshane portal (samrakshane.karnataka.gov.in).
Submit land survey number and crop details.
Pay the subsidized farmer premium online or at bank/CSC.
source_title: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Govt of India
source_excerpt: PMFBY aims at supporting sustainable production in agriculture sector by way of providing financial support to farmers suffering crop loss.
